messages:
maya: New model intake: argus-12b-chat landed in registry. Need perf bring-up + quant profile. Goal: p95 <220ms @batch=1, p50 <60ms, and >=1200 tok/s at batch=8, ctx=2048 for int8. Starting checklist.

oliver: taking this. I'll run fp16 baseline + int8 PTQ cal. Skip int4 unless int8 looks promising. ETA today.

zara: proposed checklist:
1) quick sanity eval (50 prompts)
2) fp16 perf baseline
3) int8 perf + quality (cal + eval)
4) batching window sweep (cb_window 4/8/16ms)
5) ctx-length sweep (128/512/2048)
6) coldstart warmup probe
7) KV-prefix warm/cache impact
8) autoscaler headroom sim

ben: for batching, measure continuous batching windows and micro-batch sizes. Also log batch latency percentiles and tokens/s per-slot.

oliver: bench matrix I'm queueing:
```
bench-run --model argus-12b-chat --variant fp16 --batch 1,2,4,8 --ctx 128,512,2048 --cb_window 4,8,16 --trials 5
bench-run --model argus-12b-chat --variant int8 --calib ./calib/argus-1k.json --batch 1,2,4,8 --ctx 128,512,2048 --cb_window 4,8,16 --trials 8
quality-run --model argus-12b-chat --variant int8 --eval eval-suite/redwood/llm-smoke-200 --metrics bertscore,exact_match
```

nina: coldstart tests should include cache-empty and primed runs. Priming sequence: system prompt + one ~128-token completion. Also test coldscale effect on p95.

infra-bot: deploy queued: bench-runner/argus-12b/1748200000 -> pool: perf-a100, est: 2.5h

ci-bot: artifacts will land at s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/argus-12b/1748200000/

oliver: quick FP16 sample (batch=1, ctx=512): p50:48ms, p95:190ms, tok/s (b1): 400, tok/s (b8): 1480, gpu_mem:12.1GB

zara: ok baseline looks solid. int8 gating rules: if p95 > 1.15x fp16 or BERTScore drop >2% vs fp16 then block rollout.

oliver: int8 cal done. sample (batch=1, ctx=512): p50:55ms, p95:245ms, tok/s(b8):1290, bertscore delta: -1.4%

maya: p95=245ms is above target. Two levers: 1) tighten cb_window and reduce micro-batching, 2) enable runtime's "int8-fast" kernel path / tuned kernel. If still high, consider layer-wise bypass or quant-aware finetune.

ben: testing cb_window=4ms + int8-fast now. Expect p95 improvement but possible throughput hit. Also will run int4 smoke with safety net.

oliver: observed coldstart p95 ~520ms empty cache. After priming (256 tokens) p95 ~210ms. We'll document warmup guidance.

nina: add to runbook: recommended priming = [system prompt, 1 warm completion (~128-256 tokens)], and autoscaler buffer = 25% spare for coldstarts.

oliver: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/argus-12b/1748200000/{fp16.csv,int8.csv,int8_fast.csv,int4_smoke.json,quality_report.json}

zara: next steps: if int8-fast meets latency and quality thresholds, prepare rollout note. If not, fallback to fp16 for hosted and offer int8 on Dedicated with config flags.

maya: Action items:
- oliver: finish cb_window 4/8 + int8-fast runs + int4 smoke (EOD)
- ben: hybrid kernel throughput impact sweep (EOD)
- zara: update onboarding runbook with eval thresholds, warmup recipes, sample commands (tomorrow)
- infra-bot: persist artifacts and tag model:argus-12b, run:1748200000

oliver: will ping when final CSVs uploaded. :rocket:

infra-bot: artifacts written: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/argus-12b/1748200000/{fp16.csv,int8.csv,int8_fast.csv,int4_smoke.json,quality_report.json}

maya: thanks team. If int8 can't meet the p95 bar after tuning, we'll ship fp16 and keep int8 as opt-in behind Dedicated. :thumbsup:
